title: Practicing alone
wikitext:
Everytime you run QuakeWorld, there's the option to play by yourself, practice movement or aim, alone or against bots.
You can do it on a public server ([https://tools.quake.world/servers/ look here]), or you can run your own server on the same computer you play (see [[How to server]]. == Aim == Aim maps are usually played in [[Deathmatchmode]]4 (most commonly known as dmm4), where you get full health and weapons. Popular maps are [[povdmm4]], [[end]], [[end2]], [[amphi]], among many others. Midair is a slightly different mode, where you only have rocket and frags are done only by hitting your opponent in the air. Popular maps are [[midair]] and [[Endif]].
On [[KTX]] servers, the recommended map settings are loaded when the map is loaded, so you only have to vote on the map, and type /ready to start playing immediately. == Movement == See [[Race]], [[Trick map]]. == versus Monsters == see [[Bloodfest]]. == Bots == Bots replace human players. You can spawn bots in compatible [[KTX]] servers. '''See more [[Playing with bots]]'''. In the past, bots required a specific modification, popular ones were [[Omnicron]] and [[Frogbots]]. You can also try [https://www.quakeworld.nu/forum/topic/7524/109688/humanoid/ Humanoid].
